functions.name: opMoveCurveBoundary
functions.signature: opMoveCurveBoundary(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Trims or extends a wire body to an entity or by a distance.

fields.name: wires
fields.description: The wire bodies to modify.

fields.name: moveBoundaryType
fields.description: Whether to trim or extend. Default is TRIM.

fields.name: trimTo
fields.description: Single entity to trim wires to.

fields.name: endCondition
fields.description: If moveBoundaryType is EXTEND defines whether to extend wires by a distance of to an entity. Default is BLIND.

fields.name: extensionDistance
fields.description: Distance to extend wires.

fields.name: extendTo
fields.description: Single entity to extend wires to.

fields.name: extensionShape
fields.description: Specifies how to transition into the curve extensions. Default is SOFT.

fields.name: helpPoint
fields.description: Specifies vertex used to choose a solution. If this is not provided, the closest vertex to the bounding entity will be used.

fields.name: flipHeuristics
fields.description: If true, will trim or extend from the opposite end of wires. Default is false.

functions.name: opBodyDraft
functions.signature: opBodyDraft(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Apply draft to a part by adding material. The material is added between reference edges and a parting object. These reference edges can be supplied directly, or they can be inferred from face or part queries.

fields.name: selectionType
fields.description: Topology class for input. Default is EDGES

fields.name: topEdges
fields.description: Edges to draft above parting entity.

fields.name: bottomEdges
fields.description: Edges to draft with angleBelow.
fields.requirement: Required if selectionType is EDGES and bothSides is true

fields.name: faces
fields.description: Faces to draft. This will split the face with isoclines those for the draft. Additionally, any existing edges bounding faces will be used if they mark a transition from steep faces to non-steep faces for the given pull direction and draft angle.

fields.name: bodies
fields.description: Parts to draft. This is equivalent to supplying all faces of the part in faces.

fields.name: excludeFaces
fields.description: Faces of bodies to exclude from drafting.

fields.name: angle
fields.description: The draft angle above the parting object.

fields.name: bothSides
fields.description: If true, draft on both sides of the parting object. Default is false.

fields.name: pullDirection
fields.description: The pull direction.

fields.name: draftOnSelf
fields.description: If true, then using the drafted part as the parting object. Default is false.

fields.name: partingObject
fields.description: A surface from surfaceGeometry.fs or a query to a face or sheet body.

fields.name: matchFacesAtParting
fields.description: If true, then additional material will be added to make the top and bottom of the draft align. Default is false.

fields.name: matchFaceType
fields.description: How to add material for matchFacesAtParting Default is REFERENCE_EDGE.

fields.name: cornerType
fields.description: The corner treatment to apply. Default is EXTEND.

fields.name: concaveRepair
fields.description: How to resolve intersecting draft faces. Default is NONE.

fields.name: concaveRepairRadius
fields.description: The radius for intersection repair.
fields.requirement: Required if concaveRepair is RADIUS or MIX.

fields.name: keepMaterial
fields.description: If true, an attempt will be made to keep the regions of the part protruding from the tapered faces. Default is false.

fields.name: showRefs
fields.description: If true, then debug data will be generated to show the parting surface and draft edges.

functions.name: opBoolean
functions.signature: opBoolean(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Performs a boolean operation on multiple solid and surface bodies. See also processNewBodyIfNeeded for merging new solids. joinSurfaceBodiesWithAutoMatching for merging new surfaces.

fields.name: tools
fields.description: The tool bodies.

fields.name: targets
fields.description: The target bodies.
fields.requirement: Required if OperationType is SUBTRACTION or SUBTRACT_COMPLEMENT, or if targetsAndToolsNeedGrouping is true.

fields.name: operationType
fields.description: The boolean operation to perform.
fields.example: BooleanOperationType.UNION will merge any tool bodies that intersect or abut. All tool bodies have to be of the same type (solid or surface). When operating on surfaces, surfaces must have coincident or overlapping edges. When several bodies merge, the identity of the tool that appears earliest in the query is preserved (in particular, body color and body name are taken from it). BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACTION will remove the union of all tools bodies from every target body. All tool bodies must be solid bodies. Target bodies could be either solids or surfaces. BooleanOperationType.INTERSECTION will create the intersection of all tool bodies. All bodies must be solid bodies. BooleanOperationType.SUBTRACT_COMPLEMENT will remove the complement of the union of all tool bodies from every target body. All tool bodies must be solid bodies. Target bodies could be either solids or surfaces.

fields.name: targetsAndToolsNeedGrouping
fields.description: This option is for adjusting the behavior to be more suitable for doing the boolean as part of a body-creating feature (such as extrude). Default is false.

fields.name: keepTools
fields.description: If true, the tools do not get consumed by the operation. Default is false.

fields.name: makeSolid
fields.description: In case of surface union try to join surfaces into a solid. Default is false.

functions.name: opBoundarySurface
functions.signature: opBoundarySurface(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a boundary surface fitting two ordered sets of profiles.

fields.name: uProfileSubqueries
fields.description: An ordered array of two or fewer queries for the profiles in the u direction. These can be edges or wire bodies.

fields.name: vProfileSubqueries
fields.description: An ordered array of two or fewer queries for the profiles in the v direction. These can be edges or wire bodies.

fields.name: uDerivativeInfo
fields.description: An array of maps that contain shape constraints at start and end profiles. Each map entry is required to have a profileIndex that refers to the affected profile. Optional fields include a vector to match surface tangent to, a magnitude, and booleans for matching tangents or curvature derived from faces adjacent to affected profile.
fields.example: [ { "profileIndex" : 0, "vector" : vector(1, 0, 0), "magnitude" : 2., "tangentToPlane" : true}, { "profileIndex" : 1, "adjacentFaces" : qFaces } ] The first map would constrain the resulting boundary surface at the first u profile to be tangent to plane with normal vector(1,0,0) and magnitude 2. The second map constrains the boundary surface at the second u profile to match tangents of faces defined by the query qFaces.

fields.name: vDerivativeInfo
fields.description: An array of maps analogous to uDerivativeInfo, but for v profiles.

fields.name: showIsocurves
fields.description: Show graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves on each face of the created boundary surface. Default false.

fields.name: curveCount
fields.description: When showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of each face's grid. Default 10.

fields.name: useProfileApproximation
fields.description: If true, the profiles will be reapproximated if it is likely to improve quality. Default is true.

functions.name: opCreateBSplineCurve
functions.signature: opCreateBSplineCurve(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Generates a wire body given a BSplineCurve definition. The spline must have dimension of 3 and be G1-continuous.

fields.name: bSplineCurve
fields.description: The definition of the spline.

functions.name: opCreateBSplineSurface
functions.signature: opCreateBSplineSurface(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Generates a sheet body given a BSplineSurface definition. The spline must have dimension of 3 and be G1-continuous.

fields.name: bSplineSurface
fields.description: The definition of the spline surface.

fields.name: boundaryBSplineCurves
fields.description: An array of BSplineCurves defined in the parameter space of bSplineSurface to use as the boundary of the created sheet body. The boundary must form a single closed loop on the surface. The dimension of each curve must be 2, as the boundaries are being defined in UV space of the created surface. If no boundary is supplied, the created sheet body will cover the full parameter range of bSplineSurface.

fields.name: makeSolid
fields.description: When set to true, the operation will produce a solid instead of a sheet if the surface encloses a region. Default is false.

functions.name: opCreateCompositePart
functions.signature: opCreateCompositePart(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Create a composite part.

fields.name: bodies
fields.description: Bodies from which to create the composite part. .

fields.name: closed
fields.description: A closed composite part consumes its constituent bodies, so that they are not available interactively for individual selection. Default is false.

functions.name: opModifyCompositePart
functions.signature: opModifyCompositePart(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Modifies a composite part.

fields.name: composite
fields.description: Existing composite part to modify.

fields.name: toAdd
fields.description: Bodies to add to the composite part.

fields.name: toRemove
fields.description: Bodies to remove from the composite part.

functions.name: opChamfer
functions.signature: opChamfer(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Adds a chamfer to given edges and faces.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Edges and faces to chamfer.

fields.name: chamferType
fields.description: Determines where the new edges of the chamfer are positioned.
fields.example: ChamferType.EQUAL_OFFSETS places both new edges width away from each original edge. ChamferType.TWO_OFFSETS places edges width1 and width2 away. ChamferType.OFFSET_ANGLE places one edge width away, and chamfers at an angle from that edge.

fields.name: width
fields.requirement: Required if chamferType is EQUAL_OFFSETS or OFFSET_ANGLE.

fields.name: oppositeDirection
fields.description: true to reverse the two edges.
fields.requirement: Required if chamferType is OFFSET_ANGLE or TWO_OFFSETS.

fields.name: tangentPropagation
fields.description: true to propagate the chamfer along edges tangent to those passed in. Defaults to false.

functions.name: opConstrainedSurface
functions.signature: opConstrainedSurface(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a constrained surface from the points.

fields.name: points
fields.description: An array of maps containing: point (Vector) : The position of the point we want the surface to pass through. normal (Vector) (Optional) : The direction of the normal of the surface at this point.

fields.name: tolerance
fields.description: The distance the surface is allowed to deviate from the given points. Default is 1e-6 meter.

fields.name: smooth
fields.description: If true, the surface will be optimized for smoothness. If false, it will be optimized for performance. Default is false.

fields.name: references
fields.description: For Onshape internal use.

functions.name: curveOnFaceDefinition
functions.signature: curveOnFaceDefinition(face is Query, creationType is FaceCurveCreationType, names is array, nCurves is number)

functions.signature: curveOnFaceDefinition(face is Query, creationType is FaceCurveCreationType, names is array, parameters is array)

functions.name: opCreateCurvesOnFace
functions.signature: opCreateCurvesOnFace(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Generates isoparametric curves of faces. That is, for each specified surface parameter value, creates a new wire body following the curve which keeps the surface parameter at that constant value.

fields.name: curveDefinition
fields.description: An array of CurveOnFaceDefinitions that describe group of curves per face.

fields.name: showCurves
fields.description: Whether to display isoparameteric curves in color in the preview.

fields.name: skipTrim
fields.description: Whether to skip trimming of curves by the face boundaries. Lines and arcs are always trimmed.

fields.name: useFaceParameter
fields.description: For Onshape internal use.

functions.name: opDeleteBodies
functions.signature: opDeleteBodies(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Deletes bodies from the context.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Entities to delete. Passing in entities other than bodies deletes their owning bodies.

functions.name: opDeleteFace
functions.signature: opDeleteFace(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: This is a direct editing operation that attempts to delete faces of a solid body and extend other faces to fill the hole.

fields.name: deleteFaces
fields.description: Faces to delete.

fields.name: includeFillet
fields.description: true to also delete fillets adjacent to the input faces.

fields.name: capVoid
fields.description: If capVoid is true and the deleted face cannot be filled by extending the surrounding faces, will attempt to replace the face with a planar face.

fields.name: leaveOpen
fields.description: If leaveOpen is true the void from deleting faces is left open, potentially creating a surface out of a solid body. Default is false.

functions.name: opEnclose
functions.signature: opEnclose(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Takes in a set of bodies and faces and creates solid bodies for the enclosed regions.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Bodies and faces for enclosure.

functions.name: opDraft
functions.signature: opDraft(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Applies a given draft angle to faces.

fields.name: draftType
fields.description: Specifies a reference surface (e.g. a neutral plane) or reference entity draft.
fields.example: DraftType.REFERENCE_SURFACE for a reference surface draft

fields.name: draftFaces
fields.description: The faces to draft for a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft.

fields.name: referenceSurface
fields.description: A face or plane that defines the neutral surface for a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft. draftFaces will remain unchanged where they intersect referenceSurface. Can be either a Query or a Plane.

fields.name: referenceEntityDraftOptions
fields.description: An array of maps of the form ("face", "references", "angle"). "face" should be a Query for exactly one face. "references" should be a Query for at least one edge attached to the face. The "face" will be drafted while the geometry of the "references" remains unchanged. "angle" is an optional ValueWithUnits parameter between -89.9 and 89.9 degrees which overrides the default angle parameter.

fields.name: pullVec
fields.description: The 3d direction relative to which the draft is applied.

fields.name: angle
fields.description: The draft angle, must be between 0 and 89.9 degrees.

fields.name: tangentPropagation
fields.description: For a REFERENCE_SURFACE draft, true to propagate draft across tangent faces. Default is false.

fields.name: referenceEntityPropagation
fields.description: For a REFERENCE_ENTITY draft, true to collect new reference entities and faces by pulling in edges connected to the specified reference edges. Connected edges on the same face or on tangent connected faces will be pulled in. Default is false.

fields.name: reFillet
fields.description: true to attempt to defillet draft faces before the draft and reapply the fillets after. Default is false.

fields.name: inferReferences
fields.description: true to replicate the reference face selection of the draft feature for PARTING_LINE draft. Default is false.

fields.name: partingLineSides
fields.description: Specifies whether to draft one or both faces adjacent to the parting edges, and whether the draft should be symmetrical if drafting both faces. See PartingLineSides.

fields.name: secondAngle
fields.description: The second draft angle for a TWO_SIDED PARTING_LINE draft. Must be between 0 and 89.9 degrees. Note that when using TWO_SIDED, angle will be applied to faces that are away from the pull direction, from the perspective of the edge. secondAngle will be applied to faces that are along the pull direction, from the perspective of the edge.
fields.requirement: Required if PartingLineSides is TWO_SIDED and inferReferences is true

fields.name: alongPull
fields.description: Specifies which face will be drafted in a ONE_SIDED PARTING_LINE draft if inferReferences is true. If true, the face which is more along the pull direction from the perspective of the parting edge is drafted. If false, the face which is more away from the pull direction from the perspective of the parting edge is drafted.

fields.name: negateSecondPullDirection
fields.description: If inferReferences is true, determines whether the pull direction of the draft should be reversed for the second angle of a TWO_SIDED draft. In equivalent terms, whether the draft should use -secondAngle as the second draft angle (true), or secondAngle as the second draft angle (false). Default is false.

fields.name: negatePullVec
fields.description: If inferReferences is true, whether the pull direction of the draft should be reversed. In equivalent terms, whether the draft should use -angle as the draft angle (true), or angle as the draft angle (false). Default is false.

fields.name: partingEdges
fields.description: Edges defining the parting line of the draft. These edges will remain unchanged as some adjacent faces, as defined by partingLineSides, are drafted.
fields.requirement: Required if draftFeatureType is PARTING_LINE and inferReferences is true

fields.name: hintFaces
fields.description: For Onshape internal use. For PARTING_LINE draft, specifies in advance which adjacent faces of partingEdges should be treated as more along the pull direction. When unspecified, the feature will use a geometric calculation to determine this distinction. Only used if inferReferences is true.

functions.name: opExtractWires
functions.signature: opExtractWires(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Generates wire bodies from the supplied edges. If the edges are disjoint multiple wires will be returned. If the edges overlap or cross, or more than two meet at a point, the function will fail.

fields.name: edges
fields.description: The edges to be extracted.

functions.name: opExtrude
functions.signature: opExtrude(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Extrudes one or more edges or faces in a given direction with one or two end conditions. Faces get extruded into solid bodies and edges get extruded into sheet bodies.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Edges and faces to extrude.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: The 3d direction in which to extrude.
fields.example: evOwnerSketchPlane(context, {"entity" : entities}).normal to extrude perpendicular to the owner sketch evPlane(context, {"face" : entities}).normal to extrude perpendicular to the first planar entity

fields.name: endBound
fields.description: The type of bound at the end of the extrusion. Cannot be SYMMETRIC or UP_TO_VERTEX.

fields.name: endDepth
fields.description: How far from the entities to extrude.

fields.name: endBoundEntity
fields.description: The face or body that provides the bound.
fields.requirement: Required if endBound is UP_TO_SURFACE or UP_TO_BODY.

fields.name: endTranslationalOffset
fields.description: The translational offset between the extrude end cap and the end bound entity. The direction vector for this is the same as direction: negative values pull the end cap away from the bound entity when endDepth is positive. endOffset will only have an effect if endBound is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.

fields.name: startBound
fields.description: The type of start bound. Default is for the extrude to start at entities. Cannot be SYMMETRIC or UP_TO_VERTEX.

fields.name: isStartBoundOpposite
fields.description: Whether the startBound extends in the opposite direction from the profile as the endBound. Defaults to true if not supplied.
fields.requirement: Required if is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.

fields.name: startDepth
fields.description: How far from the entities to start the extrude. The direction vector for this is the negative of direction: positive values make the extrusion longer when endDepth is positive.

fields.name: startBoundEntity
fields.description: The face or body that provides the bound.
fields.requirement: Required if startBound is UP_TO_SURFACE or UP_TO_BODY.

fields.name: startTranslationalOffset
fields.description: The translational offset between the extrude start cap and the start bound entity. The direction vector for this is the negative of direction: negative values pull the end cap away from the bound entity when startDepth is positive. startOffset will only have an effect if startBound is UP_TO_SURFACE, UP_TO_BODY, or UP_TO_NEXT.

functions.name: opFaceBlend
functions.signature: opFaceBlend(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Performs a face blend between two walls of faces.

fields.name: side1
fields.description: First set of faces, must belong to the same body.

fields.name: side2
fields.description: Second set of faces, must belong to the same body.

fields.name: flipSide1Normal
fields.description: Wether to flip side 1's normal.

fields.name: flipSide2Normal
fields.description: Wether to flip side 2's normal.

fields.name: propagation
fields.description: Whether to propagate the blend.

fields.name: propagationType
fields.description: How to propagate the blend. FaceBlendPropagation.TANGENT will propagate over tangent faces. FaceBlendPropagation.ADJACENT will propagate over all adjacent faces. FaceBlendPropagation.CUSTOM allows specification of a maximum angle between faces for propagation. Defaults is FaceBlendPropagation.TANGENT.

fields.name: propagationAngle
fields.description: Maximum angle between faces for propagation. Used if propagationType is FaceBlendPropagation.CUSTOM. Default is 0 * radian.

fields.name: crossSection
fields.description: The cross section type of the blend.

fields.name: spine
fields.description: The spine of the blend. The blend's cross section will be orthogonal to the spine.

fields.name: blendControlType
fields.description: Whether the blend is controled by a constant radius or a constant width.

fields.name: crossSectionShape
fields.description: What shape the cross section of the blend will be.

fields.name: radius
fields.description: The radius of the cross section.

fields.name: width
fields.description: The width of the blend.

fields.name: asymmetric
fields.description: Wether the radius or width is the same on each wall.

fields.name: secondRadius
fields.description: The radius of the cross section from side 2.
fields.requirement: Required if blendControlType is RADIUS and asymmetric is true.

fields.name: widthRatio
fields.description: How the blend will be divided between the walls. If widthRatio < 1, it will be wider towards side 1. If widthRatio > 1, it will be wider towards side 2.
fields.requirement: Required if blendControlType is WIDTH and asymmetric is true.

fields.name: rho
fields.description: Parameter of the conic cross section shape.

fields.name: magnitude
fields.description: Parameter of the curvature cross section shape.

fields.name: tangentHoldLines
fields.description: Whether to use the content of tangentEdges and inverseTangentEdges.

fields.name: tangentEdges
fields.description: Edges to use as tangent hold lines.

fields.name: inverseTangentEdges
fields.description: Edges to use as inverse tangent hold lines.

fields.name: conicHoldLines
fields.description: Whether to use the content of conicEdges and inverseConicEdges.

fields.name: conicEdges
fields.description: Edges to use as conic hold lines.

fields.name: inverseConicEdges
fields.description: Edges to use as inverse conic hold lines.

fields.name: hasCliffEdges
fields.description: Whether to use the content of cliffEdges.

fields.name: cliffEdges
fields.description: Edges to use as cliff edges.

fields.name: hasCaps
fields.description: Whether to use the content of caps.

fields.name: caps
fields.description: Entities and flip flags to use as caps. Each map should contain an entity Query element and a flip boolean element.

fields.name: hasLimits
fields.description: Whether to use the content of limitPlane1, limitPlane2, faceLimits and edgeLimit.

fields.name: limitPlane1
fields.description: First plane to limit the blend.

fields.name: limitPlane1Flip
fields.description: Whether to flip the first plane normal. Defines which side of the plane the blend will be.

fields.name: limitPlane2
fields.description: Second plane to limit the blend.

fields.name: limitPlane2Flip
fields.description: Whether to flip the first plane normal. Defines which side of the plane the blend will be.

fields.name: faceLimits
fields.description: Faces to use as limits to the blend.

fields.name: edgeLimit
fields.description: Edges and adjacent faces to use as limits. Each map should contain an edge Query element and an edgeLimitSide query element.

fields.name: hasHelpPoint
fields.description: Whether to use the content of helpPoint.

fields.name: helpPoint
fields.description: Vertex or mate connector to use as help point. In case the blend parameters create several blends, only the blend closest to the help point will be kept.

fields.name: trim
fields.description: How to trim the blend.

fields.name: detach
fields.description: Whether not to attach the blend(s) to the sides, creating new sheet bodies.

fields.name: showIsocurves
fields.description: Show graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves of the created surface. Default false.

fields.name: curveCount
fields.description: When showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of the grid. Default 10.

functions.name: opFillet
functions.signature: opFillet(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: For edges, performs a fillet on the edge. For faces, performs a fillet on all edges adjacent to the face.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Edges and faces to fillet.

fields.name: radius
fields.description: The fillet radius.

fields.name: tangentPropagation
fields.description: true to propagate the fillet along edges tangent to those passed in. Default is false.

fields.name: crossSection
fields.description: Fillet cross section. One of CIRCULAR, CONIC, CURVATURE. Default is CIRCULAR.

fields.name: rho
fields.description: A number between 0 and 1, specifying the Rho value of a conic fillet
fields.example: 0.01 creates a flat, nearly-chamfered shape. 0.99 creates a pointed, nearly-unchanged shape.

fields.name: magnitude
fields.description: A number between 0 and 1, specifying the magnitude of curvature match.

fields.name: partialFilletBounds
fields.description: An array of maps representing the boundaries of a partial fillet. Each map should contain a boundaryEdge query, a boundaryParameter value, a isFlipped boolean

fields.name: isVariable
fields.description: Fillet controls can be varied at vertices via vertexSettings. Default is false.

fields.name: vertexSettings
fields.description: An array of maps representing fillet settings at specified vertices. Each map should contain a vertex query, a vertexRadius value, a variableMagnitude if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CURVATURE, and a variableRho if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CONIC.

fields.name: pointOnEdgeSettings
fields.description: An array of maps representing fillet settings at specified points on edges. Each map should contain an edge query, an edgeParameter value, a pointOnEdgeRadius value, a pointOnEdgeVariablMagnitude if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CURVATURE, and a pointOnEdgeVariableRho if the crossSection is FilletCrossSection.CONIC.

fields.name: smoothTransition
fields.description: Whether to create a smoother transition between each vertex.

fields.name: allowEdgeOverflow
fields.description: Allow opFillet to modify nearby edges to maintain the fillet profile. Default is true.

fields.name: keepEdges

fields.name: smoothCorners
fields.description: Allow opFillet to smooth all suitable corners and prevent creation of sharp edges. Default is false.

fields.name: smoothCornerExceptions
fields.description: Vertices you do not want opFillet to smooth if smoothCorners is true.

fields.name: createDetachedSurface
fields.description: Operation does not modify the body of the selected edges, but results in surface geometry of fillet. Default is false.

functions.name: opFillSurface
functions.signature: opFillSurface(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Generates a surface body from supplied boundary and internal constraints. The boundaries are defined as edge queries for each continuity constraint. The internal constraints may be defined as a set of support vertices.

fields.name: edgesG0

fields.name: edgesG1
fields.description: The edges with tangency constraints.

fields.name: edgesG2
fields.description: The edges with curvature constraints.

fields.name: guideVertices
fields.description: The vertices the resulting surface is expected to interpolate.

fields.name: showIsocurves
fields.description: Show graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves of the created surface. Default false.

fields.name: curveCount
fields.description: When showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of the grid. Default 10.

functions.name: opFitSpline
functions.signature: opFitSpline(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a 3D cubic spline curve through an array of 3D points.

fields.name: points
fields.description: An array of Vectors with length units for the spline to interpolate. If the first point is the same as the last point, the spline is closed.
fields.example: [ vector( 1, 1, 1) * inch, vector(-1, 1, -1) * inch, vector( 1, -1, -1) * inch, vector(-1, -1, 1) * inch, vector( 1, 1, 1) * inch ]

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: An array of doubles, parameters corresponding to the points.

fields.name: startDerivative
fields.description: A Vector with length units that specifies the derivative at the start of the resulting spline (according to the arcLengthParameterization set to false).

fields.name: endDerivative
fields.description: A Vector with length units that specifies the derivative at the end of the resulting spline. Ignored if spline is closed.

fields.name: start2ndDerivative
fields.description: A Vector with length units that specifies the second derivative at the start of the resulting spline. Ignored if spline is closed, or if startDerivative is not defined

fields.name: end2ndDerivative
fields.description: A Vector with length units that specifies the second derivative at the end of the resulting spline. Ignored if spline is closed, or if endDerivative is not defined

fields.name: derivatives
fields.description: A map of derivatives at non-end points. Entries should be index : derivative, where index is an integer between 1 and size(points) - 2 and derivative is a Vector that specifies the derivative at points[index].

fields.name: hasTargetLength
fields.description: Whether the spline should attempt to match a target length. Default is false.

fields.name: targetLength
fields.description: The target length of the resulting spline. Only used if hasTargetLength is true.

functions.description: Reverses the orientation of sheet bodies.

fields.name: bodies
fields.description: Sheet bodies whose orientation should be flipped.

functions.name: opFullRoundFillet
functions.signature: opFullRoundFillet(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a full round fillet, replacing the center face(s) with circular profile face(s) of varying radius, joining the selected side faces.

fields.name: side1Face
fields.description: A face on one side of the blend.

fields.name: side2Face
fields.description: A face on another side of the blend.

fields.name: centerFaces
fields.description: The face(s) to be replaced.

fields.name: tangentPropagation
fields.description: true to propagate the fillet across side face tangencies. Default is true.

functions.name: opHelix
functions.signature: opHelix(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a helical and possibly spiral curve.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: The direction of the helix axis.

fields.name: axisStart
fields.description: A point on the helix axis.

fields.name: startPoint
fields.description: The start point of the infinite helix. Must be off the axis. This is the point at which the created curve would actually start if the first number of interval is 0.

fields.name: interval
fields.description: An array of two numbers denoting the interval of the helix in terms of revolution counts.
fields.example: [0, 10] will create a curve with 10 revolutions.

fields.name: clockwise
fields.example: true if this is a clockwise helix when viewed along direction.

fields.name: helicalPitch
fields.description: Distance along the axis between successive revolutions.
fields.example: 0.1 * inch will create a helix with 10 revolutions per inch. 0 * inch produces a planar Archimedean spiral.

fields.name: spiralPitch
fields.description: Change in radius between successive revolutions.
fields.example: 0 * inch produces a helix that lies on a cylinder.

functions.name: opHole
functions.signature: opHole(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates hole tools referencing a set of targets, optionally subtracting the tools from the targets. If some tools cannot be built, the operation will still succeed and indicate in its return value which holes failed to build. If no tools can be built, the operation will fail.

fields.name: holeDefinition
fields.description: The definition of the shape of the desired holes.

fields.name: axes
fields.description: An array of Lines each of whose origin represents the start position of a hole, and whose direction represents the drill direction of the hole.

fields.name: identities
fields.description: An array of queries, one per axis in axes, used to disambiguate each of the created holes. Each query should resolve to exactly one entity. Providing this information does not change the geometric outcome, but stabilizes references to the holes with respect to upstream changes to the model.

fields.name: targets
fields.description: A set of bodies to target. The shape of the produced holes is dependent on the shape of these targets (as specified in the supplied HoleDefinition), so the full set of targeted bodies should always be supplied, even if subtractFromTargets is false.
fields.requirement: Required if holeDefinition contains any profiles that do not reference HolePositionReference.AXIS_POINT, or if subtractFromTargets is true

fields.name: subtractFromTargets
fields.description: true if the hole geometry should be subtracted from the targets. false if the targets should not be modified, and the hole tools should be outputted as new solid bodies. Default is true. To subtract from a subset of targets, set this to true and supply a set of excluded targets as targetsToExcludeFromSubtraction. Removing the set of excluded targets from targets instead of using targetsToExcludeFromSubtraction is not the correct way to call this interface, and may result in the shape of the hole changing.

fields.name: targetsToExcludeFromSubtraction
fields.description: If supplied and subtractFromTargets is true, the given targets are excluded from the subtraction. Ignored if subtractFromTargets is false

fields.name: keepTools
fields.description: If subtractFromTargets is true, controls whether the hole tools should be outputted as new solid bodies. Default is false. Ignored if subtractFromTargets is false; in that case hole tools are always outputted as new solid bodies.

parameters.description: An array representing target intersection information for each hole. The array is aligned with the axes input. Each item in the array is a map containing a boolean field success, which indicates whether the tool was successfully built. If success is true the map will contain three additional entries: targetToDepthExtremes, positionReferenceInfo and holeDepth. The value of targetToDepthExtremes is a map mapping the targets that the given hole intersects to a map of intersection information for those targets. Only targets that are intersected by the hole will be present in the map. Each map key is a Query for one of the targets, and the corresponding value is itself a map of the form { "firstEntrance" : firstEntranceDistance, "fullEntrance" : fullEntranceDistance, "firstExit" : firstExitDistance, "fullExit" : fullExitDistance } firstEntranceDistance, fullEntranceDistance, firstExitDistance, and fullExitDistance are ValueWithUnits representing distances, along the axis, from the origin point of the axis to various important markers on the infinite hole cylinder. firstEntranceDistance and fullEntranceDistance represent the range over which the infinite hole cylinder enters the part, with firstEntranceDistance representing where the infinite hole cylinder first enters the part, and fullEntranceDistance representing where the infinite hole cylinder fully enters the part. These values are distinct when the entrance face into the part is slanted (or otherwise irregular). firstExitDistance and fullExitDistance similarly represent the range over which the infinite hole cylinder exits the part. The value of positionReferenceInfo is a map whose keys are the HolePositionReferences found in the holeDefinition and whose value is a map of the form { "referenceRootStart" : referenceRootStartDistance, "referenceRootEnd" : referenceRootEndDistance, "target" : targetQuery }. referenceRootStartDistance is a ValueWithUnits representing the distance, along the axis, from the origin point of the axis to the first coincidence between the infinite hole cylinder and the reference in question. referenceRootEndDistance is a similar measurement to the last coincidence between the infinite hole cylinder and the reference in question. For flat references, such as a TARGET_START referencing the top face of a cube, these two values will be the same. The values will differ for slanted (or otherwise irregular) references where the infinite hole cylinder interacts with the reference over a range, rather than at a single distance. targetQuery is a Query for the target that defines that position reference. holeDepth is a ValueWithUnits representing the distance, along the axis from the first entrance of the intersected targets to the termination entity. Used for references such as UP_TO_ENTITY and UP_TO_NEXT to get a calculated depth of a hole.
parameters.example: // For an opHole operation creating two holes, both going into two stacked // parts, the first of which being 1 inch thick with a slightly slanted top // and flat bottom and the second being 3 inches thick with a flat top and // bottom, and the holeDefinition referencing both TARGET_START and // LAST_TARGET_START the return value may look like: [ { // First hole (successful) "success" : true, "targetToDepthExtremes" : { (firstTargetQuery) : { "firstEntrance" : 0.1 * inch, "fullEntrance" : 0.3 * inch, "firstExit" : 1 * inch, "fullExit" : 1 * inch }, (secondTargetQuery) : { "firstEntrance" : 1 * inch, "fullEntrance" : 1 * inch, "firstExit" : 4 * inch, "fullExit" : 4 * inch } }, "positionReferenceInfo" : { HolePositionReference.TARGET_START : { "referenceRootStart" : 0.1 * inch, "referenceRootEnd" : 0.3 * inch, "target" : firstTargetQuery }, HolePositionReference.LAST_TARGET_START : { "referenceRootStart" : 1 * inch, "referenceRootEnd" : 1 * inch, "target" : secondTargetQuery }, } }, { // Second hole (successful) "success" : true, "targetToDepthExtremes" : { (firstTargetQuery) : { "firstEntrance" : 0.4 * inch, "fullEntrance" : 0.6 * inch, "firstExit" : 1 * inch, "fullExit" : 1 * inch }, (secondTargetQuery) : { "firstEntrance" : 1 * inch, "fullEntrance" : 1 * inch, "firstExit" : 4 * inch, "fullExit" : 4 * inch } }, "positionReferenceInfo" : { HolePositionReference.TARGET_START : { "referenceRootStart" : 0.4 * inch, "referenceRootEnd" : 0.6 * inch, "target" : firstTargetQuery }, HolePositionReference.LAST_TARGET_START : { "referenceRootStart" : 1 * inch, "referenceRootEnd" : 1 * inch, "target" : secondTargetQuery }, } }, { // Third hole (unsuccessful) "success" : false } ]

functions.name: opImportForeign
functions.signature: opImportForeign(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Brings foreign geometry into the context. This function is used for importing uploaded parts.

fields.name: blobData
fields.description: Reference to a blob element hosting uploaded CAD data.

fields.name: flatten
fields.description: Whether to flatten assemblies; defaults to false.

fields.name: yAxisIsUp
fields.description: If true, the y axis in the import maps to the z axis and z maps to -y. If false (default), the coordinates are unchanged.

fields.name: isModifiable
fields.description: Whether the imported data is modifiable (default) or not.

functions.name: opCreateIsocline
functions.signature: opCreateIsocline(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates wires corresponding to the given faces's isocline edges. Each isocline follows a path along a face with a constant angle in the (-90, 90) degree range (e.g., lines of latitude on a sphere). This angle is the face tangent plane's angle with respect to the direction with its sign determined by the dot product of direction and the face normal, and is analogous to the angle used in draft analysis. Depending on the face geometry, there may be zero, one, or multiple isoclines on each face.

fields.name: faces
fields.description: The faces on which to imprint isoclines.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: A reference direction.

fields.name: angle
fields.description: The isocline angle with respect to the direction in the (-90, 90) degree range.

functions.name: opLoft
functions.signature: opLoft(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a surface or solid loft fitting an ordered set of profiles, optionally constrained by guide curves.

fields.name: profileSubqueries
fields.description: An ordered array of queries for the profiles. For a solid loft, these must be sheet bodies, faces, or vertices. For a surface loft, these could be wire bodies, sheet bodies, faces, edges, or vertices.

fields.name: guideSubqueries
fields.description: An array of queries for guide curves. Each guide curve should intersect each profile once.

fields.name: connections
fields.description: An array of maps to define multiple profile alignments. Each connection map should contain: (1) connectionEntities query describing an array of vertices or edges (one per profile), (2) connectionEdges an array of individual queries for edges in connectionEntities. The order of individual edge queries should be synchronized with connectionEdgeParameters. (3) connectionEdgeParameters array - an ordered and synchronized array of parameters on edges in connectionEdgeQueries

fields.name: connectionsArcLengthParameterization
fields.description: Defaults to false for better performance. Controls interpretation of connectionEdgeParameters. If evDistance, evEdgeTangentLine etc. are called in conjunction with opLoft the same value should be passed as arcLengthParameterization there.

fields.name: makePeriodic
fields.description: Defaults to false. A closed guide creates a periodic loft regardless of this option.

fields.name: bodyType
fields.description: Specifies a SOLID or SURFACE loft. Default is SOLID.

fields.name: trimGuidesByProfiles
fields.description: If false (default) use full length of guides. If true restrict resulting surface by the first and last profile. Meaningful only for non-periodic surface loft.

fields.name: trimProfiles
fields.description: If false (default) use full length of profiles. If true restrict resulting surface by the first and last guide or connection. Meaningful only for surface loft with open profiles.

fields.name: derivativeInfo
fields.description: An array of maps that contain shape constraints at start and end profiles. Each map entry is required to have a profileIndex that refers to the affected profile. Optional fields include a vector to match surface tangent to, a magnitude, and booleans for matching tangents or curvature derived from faces adjacent to affected profile.
fields.example: [ { "profileIndex" : 0, "vector" : vector(1, 0, 0), "magnitude" : 2., "tangentToPlane" : true}, { "profileIndex" : 1, "matchCurvature" : true, "adjacentFaces" : qFaces } ] The first map would constrain the resulting loft at the start profile to be tangent to plane with normal vector(1,0,0) and magnitude 2. The second map constrains the loft at the end profile to match the curvature of faces defined by the query qFaces.

fields.name: showIsocurves
fields.description: Show graphical representation of a subset of isoparameteric curves on each face of the created loft. Default false.

fields.name: curveCount
fields.description: When showIsocurves is true, the number of curves to draw in each direction of each face's grid. Default 10.

fields.name: loftTopology
fields.description: Specifies topology of lofted body. Default is MINIMAL.

fields.name: addSections
fields.description: true to add a path. Default is false.

fields.name: spine
fields.description: Query to specify the edge for the path.

fields.name: sectionCount
fields.description: Number of sections to add. Required if addSections=true.

functions.name: opMateConnector
functions.signature: opMateConnector(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a mate connector, which represents a coordinate system in the context. Currently it is a special type of point body.

fields.name: coordSystem
fields.description: The mate connector coordinate system.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: The owner body of the mate connector: when the owner is brought into an assembly, owned mate connectors will be brought in and move rigidly with it. If the query resolves to multiple bodies, the first is taken as the owner.

fields.name: attachTo
fields.description: A face or body query to which mate connector will be attached - will follow it in downstream transformations.

functions.name: opMergeContexts
functions.signature: opMergeContexts(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Bring all of the information from contextFrom into context. This is used, for example, for the Derived feature.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: The target context.

fields.name: contextFrom
fields.description: The source context. It is rendered unusable by this operation.

fields.name: trackThroughMerge
fields.description: Array of queries to map evaluation result in contextFrom to context post-merge

parameters.description: Returns array of the same size as trackThroughMerge with evaluation results for each query(array of arrays of transient queries).

functions.name: opModifyFillet
functions.signature: opModifyFillet(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: This is a direct editing operation that modifies or deletes fillets.

fields.name: faces
fields.description: The fillets to modify.

fields.name: modifyFilletType
fields.description: Whether to change the fillet radii or remove them altogether.

fields.name: radius
fields.description: The new radius.

fields.name: reFillet
fields.description: true to reapply adjacent fillets. Default is false.

functions.name: opMoveFace
functions.signature: opMoveFace(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: This is a direct editing operation that applies a transform to one or more faces.

fields.name: moveFaces
fields.description: The faces to transform.

fields.name: transform
fields.description: The transform to apply to the face.
fields.example: transform(vector(0, 0, 1) * inch) will translate the face 1 inch along the world's z-axis.

fields.name: reFillet
fields.description: true to attempt to defillet moveFaces prior to the move and reapply the fillet after. Default is false.

fields.name: mergeFaces
fields.description: true to remove redundant edges from moveFaces. Default is true.

functions.name: opOffsetFace
functions.signature: opOffsetFace(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: This is a direct editing operation that offsets one or more faces.

fields.name: moveFaces
fields.description: The faces to offset.

fields.name: offsetDistance
fields.description: The positive or negative distance by which to offset.
fields.example: 0.1 * inch will offset the face 0.1 inches, normal to the face.

fields.name: reFillet
fields.description: true to attempt to defillet moveFaces prior to the offset and reapply the fillet after. Default is false.

fields.name: mergeFaces
fields.description: true to remove redundant edges from moveFaces. Default is true.

functions.name: opPattern
functions.signature: opPattern(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Patterns input faces and/or bodies by applying transforms to them. The original faces and bodies are preserved.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Bodies and faces to pattern.

fields.name: transforms
fields.description: An array of Transforms to apply to entities. The transforms do not have to be rigid.

fields.name: instanceNames
fields.description: An array of distinct non-empty strings the same size as transforms to identify the patterned entities. Similar to an Id, an instance names may consist only of letters, numbers, and any of +, -, /, _.

fields.name: copyPropertiesAndAttributes
fields.description: If true (default), copies properties and attributes to patterned entities.

fields.name: companionBodyPattern
fields.description: used in feature-selection patterns

fields.name: companionFacePatternSeeds
fields.description: used in feature-selection patterns

functions.name: opPlane
functions.signature: opPlane(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a construction plane.

fields.name: plane
fields.description: The plane to create.

fields.name: width
fields.description: The side length of the construction plane, as it is initially displayed.

fields.name: height
fields.description: The side length of the construction plane, as it is initially displayed.

fields.name: defaultType
fields.description: For Onshape internal use.

functions.name: opPolyline
functions.signature: opPolyline(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a polyline passing through an array of 3D points.

fields.name: points
fields.description: An array of Vectors with length units corresponding the points of the polyline. If the firstpoint is the same as the last point, the polyline is closed.
fields.example: [ vector( 1, 1, 1) * inch, vector(-1, 1, -1) * inch, vector( 1, -1, -1) * inch, vector(-1, -1, 1) * inch, vector( 1, 1, 1) * inch ]

fields.name: bendRadii
fields.description: An array of ValueWithUnits, corresponding to the bend radii at each point. The value at index i corresponds to the bend at the point at index i + 1 in points. A value of 0 * meter means no bend at the corresponding point. Its size should be size(points) - 2 for an open polyline, size(points) - 1 for a closed one.

functions.name: opDropCurve
functions.signature: opDropCurve(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Projects curves on a face.

fields.name: tools
fields.description: The edges to project.

fields.name: targets
fields.description: The faces/bodies the edges are to be projected onto.

fields.name: projectionType
fields.description: Projection method.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: The direction in which to project the curve. Required if projectionType is ProjectionType.DIRECTION.

functions.name: opIntersectFaces
functions.signature: opIntersectFaces(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Intersect two faces, creating curves appropriately.

fields.name: tools
fields.description: First array of faces to intersect.

fields.name: targets
fields.description: Second array of faces to intersect.

functions.name: opSphere
functions.signature: opSphere(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a sphere.

fields.name: radius
fields.description: The radius of the sphere.

fields.name: center
fields.description: The location of the center of the sphere.

functions.name: opSplineThroughEdges
functions.signature: opSplineThroughEdges(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a 3D spline curve representing a sequence of edges. The edges must form a tangent-continuous chain.

fields.name: edges
fields.description: Edges to approximate.

functions.name: opSplitEdges
functions.signature: opSplitEdges(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Splits an array of edges with an entity or at specified parameters.

fields.name: edges
fields.description: Edges to split.

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: An array of array of parameters. Each edge gets split at the parameter values at the matching index in this array.

fields.name: splittingSurface
fields.description: A sheet body, a construction plane or a face to cut with. Can be either a Query or a Plane. Either splittingSurface or parameters must be specified but not both.

fields.name: arcLengthParameterization
fields.description: If true (default), the parameter returned for edges measures distance along the edge, so 0.5 is the midpoint. If false, use an arbitrary but faster-to-calculate parameterization. Default is true.

functions.name: opPoint
functions.signature: opPoint(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a construction point (a BodyType.POINT with one vertex).

fields.name: point
fields.description: The location of the point.

fields.name: origin
fields.description: For Onshape internal use.

functions.name: opReplaceFace
functions.signature: opReplaceFace(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: This is a direct editing operation that replaces the geometry one or more faces with that of another face or multiple adjacent faces, possibly with an offset.

fields.name: replaceFaces
fields.description: The faces whose geometry to replace.

fields.name: templateFace
fields.description: The face or multiple adjacent faces whose geometry to use as the replacement.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: The positive or negative distance by which to offset the resulting face.

fields.name: oppositeSense
fields.description: If true, flip the surface normal of the resulting face, which may be necessary to match the surface normals of surrounding faces. Default is false.

functions.name: opRevolve
functions.signature: opRevolve(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Revolves edges and faces about an axis to produce sheet and solid bodies. The edges and faces may abut, but not strictly intersect the axis.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: The edges and faces to revolve.

fields.name: axis
fields.description: The axis around which to revolve.

fields.name: angleForward
fields.description: The angle where the revolve ends relative to entities. Normalized to the range \[0, 2 PI).

fields.name: angleBack
fields.description: The angle where the revolve starts relative to entities. Normalized to the range \[0, 2 PI). If angleForward == angleBack, the revolve is a full (360-degree) revolve. Defaults to 0.

functions.name: opRuledSurface
functions.signature: opRuledSurface(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Creates a ruled surface along a set of paths. Direction of ruled surface is specified with either ruledDirection or angleFromFaces.

fields.name: path
fields.description: The edges that form the paths for the ruled surface.

fields.name: cornerType
fields.description: How corners in the ruled surface are handled. Default is RuledSurfaceCornerType.SPUN.

fields.name: useCubicInterpolation
fields.description: Ruled surface will use a cubic interpolation if true. Otherwise, a linear interpolation will be used. Default is true.

fields.name: width
fields.description: The width of the ruled surface.

fields.name: ruledSurfaceType
fields.description: Specifies how the ruled surface is constructed.

fields.name: ruledDirection
fields.description: Ruled surface will be aligned with this vector.

fields.name: angle
fields.description: The angle at which the ruled surface meets reference faces or ruledDirection. Default is 0.

fields.name: referenceFaces
fields.description: A set of faces from which to measure angleFromFaces.

fields.name: vertex
fields.description: A vertex on the path where the override is applied.

fields.name: ruledDirection
fields.description: If specified, override will specify local direction of ruled surface along this vector.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Width of ruled surface at this override.
fields.requirement: Required if ruledDirection != undefined or angleFromFaces != undefined

fields.name: angleFromFaces
fields.description: If specified, override will specify direction as an angle to reference faces. This is only applicable if angleFromFaces is also specified at the top level.

fields.name: upToEntity
fields.description: If specified, override will specify that ruled surface touches upToEntity at override.

fields.name: manipulatorPositions
fields.description: An array of positions for which local CoordSystems will be returned.

fields.name: edge
fields.description: One of the input edges.

fields.name: parameter
fields.description: A parameter on the edge.

parameters.description: An array of local CoordSystems at the requested positions.

functions.name: opShell
functions.signature: opShell(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Create a shell of a solid body with uniform thickness. The bodies that are passed in are hollowed, omitting the walls on the face entities passed in.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: The faces to shell and solid bodies to hollow.

fields.name: thickness
fields.description: The distance by which to shell. Positive means shell outward, and negative means shell inward.

functions.name: opSplitPart
functions.signature: opSplitPart(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Split solid, sheet, and wire bodies with the given sheet body.

fields.name: targets
fields.description: The solid, sheet, and wire bodies to split.

fields.name: tool
fields.description: A sheet body, a construction plane or a face to cut with. Can be either a Query or a Plane. If a planar face is passed in, the split will extend the plane infinitely unless useTrimmed is true.

fields.name: keepTools
fields.description: If false, the tool is deleted. Default is false.

fields.name: keepType
fields.description: Controls which pieces to keep. Default is KEEP_ALL.

fields.name: useTrimmed
fields.description: If true, the trimmed face boundaries are used as the tool, rather than the underlying surface. Default is false.

functions.name: opSplitFace
functions.signature: opSplitFace(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Split faces with the given edges or faces. Returns an array of edges where the faces intersect. This includes already existing edges as well as edges that were created by opSplitFace.

fields.name: faceTargets
fields.description: The faces to split.

fields.name: edgeTools
fields.description: The edges to cut with.

fields.name: projectionType
fields.description: Edge projection method. Default is ProjectionType.NORMAL_TO_TARGET

fields.name: direction
fields.description: The projection direction.

functions.name: opSplitByIsocline
functions.signature: opSplitByIsocline(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Split the given faces by isocline edges. Each isocline follows a path along a face with a constant angle in the (-90, 90) degree range (e.g., lines of latitude on a sphere). This angle is the face tangent plane's angle with respect to the direction with its sign determined by the dot product of direction and the face normal, and is analogous to the angle used in draft analysis. Depending on the face geometry, there may be zero, one, or multiple isoclines on each face. The isocline edges are created as new edges which split the provided faces. The resulting faces are either steep (i.e., the angle is less than the input angle) or non-steep. To instead leave the original faces intact, you can first extract the faces with opExtractSurface(), and create isoclines on the resulting surfaces. The isocline edges can be queried for with qCreatedBy. The split orientation is consistent such that the non-steep faces are always in "front" of the split, and can be reliably queried for with qSplitBy: Note that qSplitBy will return only those faces that were split, while the returned SplitByIsoclineResult will include the intact faces as well.

fields.name: faces
fields.description: The faces on which to imprint isoclines.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: A reference direction.

fields.name: angle
fields.description: The isocline angle with respect to the direction in the (-90, 90) degree range.

functions.name: opSplitBySelfShadow
functions.signature: opSplitBySelfShadow(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Splits the faces of the given bodies into visible and invisible regions with respect to the given viewDirection, creating shadow curves as necessary. A shadow curve represents the transition of one face from visible to invisible. Depending on the geometry, there may be zero, one, or more shadow curves per face. The shadow curve edges are created as new edges which split the faces of the provided bodies. Each of the resulting faces is wholly visible or wholly invisible. Edge-on faces are considered invisible. The shadow curve edges can be queried for with qCreatedBy. The split orientation is consistent such that the visible faces are always in "front" of the split, and can be reliably queried for with qSplitBy: Note that qSplitBy will return only those faces that were split, while the returned SplitBySelfShadowResult will include the intact faces as well.

fields.name: bodies
fields.description: The bodies which cast shadows and on which to imprint shadow curves.

fields.name: viewDirection
fields.description: The viewing direction.

functions.name: opWrap
functions.signature: opWrap(context is Context, id is Id, definition is map)
functions.description: Wraps or unwraps faces from one surface onto another. The location and orientation of the wrapped faces on the destination surface are controlled by the anchorPoint and anchorDirection of the source and destination WrapSurfaces. The entities of the operation are not affected, the result of this operation is a new set of surface bodies or imprinted edges representing the wrapped or unwrapped faces. Faces that are topologically connected will remain topologically connected in the result body for WrapType.SIMPLE and WrapType.TRIM. This operation currently supports wrapping from a plane onto a cylinder or a cone, and unwrapping from a cylinder or a cone onto a plane. (Formerly opRoll)

fields.name: orientWithDestination
fields.description: If true (default), the normals of the resulting surface will point in the same direction as the destination. If false, the normals of the resulting surface will point in the opposite direction. For the purpose of this parameter, the normals of a WrapSurface defined by an infinite Cylinder are always pointing outwards.

functions.name: qCreatedBy
functions.signature: qCreatedBy(featureId is Id, entityType is EntityType)
functions.description: A query for all the entities created by a feature or operation. The feature is given by its feature id, which was passed into the the operation function in order to create the feature. An entity is "created by" an operation if the entity was added to the context as part of that operation. Entities modified, but not created, by an operation are not returned by this query. If an entity is split (as in a split part operation), the resulting entities are "created by" both the original entity's creator and the split part operation. If two entities are merged (as in a union of coincident faces), that entity is "created by" the creators of each merged entity, as well as the merging operation itself. If a sketch's feature id is specified, returns a query for all sketch regions, points, and wire bodies created by the specified sketch.

parameters.description: The Id of the specified feature.

AdjacencyType.EDGE will return entities that share at least an edge with the seed entities. For example, qAdjacent(whiteSquareOnChessBoard, AdjacencyType.EDGE) would return all four surrounding black squares, but not the four diagonal white squares.

parameters.name: entityType

functions.name: qSketchFilter
functions.signature: qSketchFilter(queryToFilter is Query, sketchObjectFilter is SketchObject)
functions.description: A query for all sketch entities, or all non-sketch entities in queryToFilter.

functions.name: qParallelPlanes
functions.signature: qParallelPlanes(queryToFilter is Query, normal is Vector)
functions.description: A query for all planar face entities in queryToFilter that are parallel to a plane specified by the normal vector.

parameters.name: normal
parameters.description: The normal vector to reference when checking for parallelism.

functions.name: qConvexConnectedFaces
functions.signature: qConvexConnectedFaces(seed is Query)
functions.description: A query for a set of faces connected to seed via convex edges, flood-filling across any number of convex edges. A convex edge is an edge which forms a convex angle along the full length of the edge. A convex angle is strictly less than 180 degrees for flat faces, or faces with negative curvature. If one face has positive curvature, and the other has flat or positive curvature, a convex angle is less than or equal to 180 degrees. Thus, the two bounding edges of an exterior fillet are considered convex.

functions.name: qConcaveConnectedFaces
functions.signature: qConcaveConnectedFaces(seed is Query)
functions.description: A query for a set of faces connected to seed via concave edges, flood-filling across any number of concave edges. A concave edge is an edge which forms a concave angle along the full length of the edge. A concave angle is strictly greater than 180 degrees for flat faces, or faces with positive curvature. If one face has negative curvature, and the other has flat or negative curvature, a concave angle is less than or equal to 180 degrees. Thus, the two bounding edges of an interior fillet are considered concave.

functions.name: qTangentConnectedFaces
functions.signature: qTangentConnectedFaces(seed is Query)
functions.description: A query for a set of faces connected to seed via tangent edges, flood-filling across any number of tangent edges. A tangent edge is an edge joining two faces such that the surface direction is continuous across the edge, at every point along the full length of the edge.

functions.name: qTangentConnectedFaces
functions.signature: qTangentConnectedFaces(seed is Query, angleTolerance is ValueWithUnits)
functions.description: A query for a set of faces connected to seed via tangent edges, flood-filling across any number of tangent edges. A tangent edge is an edge joining two faces such that the surface direction is continuous across the edge, up to the given angleTolerance, at every point along the full length of the edge.

functions.name: qTangentConnectedEdges
functions.signature: qTangentConnectedEdges(seed is Query)
functions.description: A query for a chain of tangent edges connected to seed via tangent vertices, chaining across any number of tangent vertices.

functions.name: qLoopEdges
functions.signature: qLoopEdges(seed is Query)
functions.description: A query for a set of edges defining a loop. If the seed has laminar edges, this query will extend to include all laminar loops that contain any seed edges. If the seed has faces, the result will include the loops forming the outer boundary of the joined faces. The order of entities returned by this function is arbitrary (and generally not predictable). Use constructPath to order the results.

functions.name: qParallelEdges
functions.signature: qParallelEdges(queryToFilter is Query, direction is Vector)
functions.description: A query for all linear edges in queryToFilter which are parallel (or anti-parallel) to the given direction.

functions.name: qParallelEdges
functions.signature: qParallelEdges(queryToFilter is Query, edges is Query)
functions.description: A query to find all linear edges in queryToFilter which are parallel (or anti-parallel) to any linear edge in edges.

functions.name: qLoopBoundedFaces
functions.signature: qLoopBoundedFaces(faceAndEdge is Query)
functions.description: Given a face and an edge, query for all faces bounded by the given face, on the side of the given edge. For example, to select an entire pocket, pass in the face which surrounds the pocket, and an edge of the face which touches that pocket.

parameters.name: faceAndEdge
parameters.description: Should match a face and an edge. If multiple faces and edges match, used the first face and the first edge.

functions.name: qFaceOrEdgeBoundedFaces
functions.signature: qFaceOrEdgeBoundedFaces(faceAndBoundingEntities is Query)
functions.description: Given a seed face and bounding entities, matches all adjacent faces inside the bounding entities, expanding from the seed face.

parameters.name: faceAndBoundingEntities
parameters.description: A Query for the seed face, followed by any boundary faces or edges. The seed face must be first, so a qUnion should be used to guarantee the order.

functions.name: qHoleFaces
functions.signature: qHoleFaces(seed is Query)
functions.description: Given a single face inside a hole or hole-like geometry, returns all faces of that hole.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: A query for a single face inside the hole.

functions.name: qSketchRegion
functions.signature: qSketchRegion(featureId is Id, filterInnerLoops is boolean)
functions.description: A query for all fully enclosed, 2D regions created by a sketch.

parameters.name: featureId
parameters.description: The feature id of the Sketch being queried.

parameters.name: filterInnerLoops
parameters.description: Specifies whether to exclude sketch regions fully contained in other sketch regions. A region whose border has a vertex or edge on the outside boundary is not considered "contained." Default is false.

functions.name: qSketchRegion
functions.signature: qSketchRegion(featureId is Id)

functions.name: qUniqueVertices
functions.signature: qUniqueVertices(vertices is Query)
functions.description: A query that filters out duplicate vertices. When duplicates are found, the vertex with the lowest deterministic ID is used.

functions.name: qMateConnectorsOfParts
functions.signature: qMateConnectorsOfParts(parts is Query)
functions.description: A query for all mate connectors owned by parts.

functions.name: qFilletFaces
functions.signature: qFilletFaces(facesToCompareTo is Query, compareType is CompareType)
functions.description: A query for fillet faces of radius equal to, less than or equal to, or greater than or equal to the input faces. If facesToCompareTo does not match one or more fillet faces, the resulting query will not match any faces. Will find the fillet radius from each face and compare to find faces of all fillets on that body that satisfy the compareType. If facesToCompareTo resolves to multiple fillet faces, all are matched independently. That is, qFilletFaces(qUnion([q1, q2], compareType)) returns the same thing as qUnion([qFilletFaces(q1, compareType), qFilletFaces(q2, compareType)]).

functions.name: qMatching
functions.signature: qMatching(referenceEntities is Query)
functions.description: Matches any faces or edges within owner bodies of entities in referenceEntities which are geometrically identical (same size and shape) to the face or edge in referenceEntities. If referenceEntities resolves to multiple entities, all are matched independently. That is, qMatching(qUnion([q1, q2])) returns the same thing as qUnion([qMatching(q1), qMatching(q2)]).

functions.name: qPatternInstances
functions.signature: qPatternInstances(featureId is Id, instanceNames is array, entityType is EntityType)
functions.description: A query for entities created by a specific instance or instances of an opPattern operation.

parameters.name: featureId

parameters.name: instanceNames
parameters.description: The names of the instances to query for, a subset of the instanceNames passed into the opPattern operation.

functions.name: qPatternInstances
functions.signature: qPatternInstances(featureId is Id, instanceName is string, entityType is EntityType)

functions.name: qDependency

functions.description: A query for the true dependency of the given dependentEntities, specifically for use with wire edges that have been created from laminar edges. If the immediate dependency is not laminar then it will track back until it reaches a laminar dependency (if there is one).

functions.name: qContainsPoint
functions.signature: qContainsPoint(queryToFilter is Query, point is Vector)
functions.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter containing a specified point.

parameters.name: point

functions.name: qIntersectsLine

functions.description: A query for all entities (bodies, faces, edges, or points) in queryToFilter touching a specified infinite line.

functions.name: qIntersectsPlane
